Dry-run fixture for E2-008 (Stage C dry-run, 30 records).
Generated by scripts/select_dry_run_records.py — deterministic.

Selection criteria (E2-008 §1):
  - Stratified by (contract_value_band x method_flag x regime).
  - 5 records per contract_value_band (4 bands = 20 records).
  - Within a band, method_flag=present preferred (rarer); then absent.
    Ties broken by OCID ascending.
  - Remaining 10 records added by OCID-ascending walk of the
    283-record E1 corpus.
  - The 3 E2-007 smoke OCIDs are force-included by displacing
    the tail of the OCID-asc remainder (never a band-quota pick).
  - Final list sorted by OCID for stable fixture bytes.

metadata) matching the runner contract, plus an `e1_reference`
block with the E1 archive verdicts. The orchestrator strips
`e1_reference` before sending to the agent (via the dry-run
driver's _drop_e1_reference).
